slug: 全球守护灵开局获得东皇帝俊
content_zh:
冥界，秦域，咸阳城。
正值中午十二点，艳阳高照之际。
一道婴儿的啼哭声，打破了往日里庄严肃穆的咸阳城内的平静。
无数的冥气向着咸阳城主府内，疯狂的聚拢。
直奔婴儿啼哭之处，涌入了婴儿的身体之中。
天空之中原本散发着金色光芒的烈阳，也突然化为了紫色。
随后更是出现了九道黑龙虚影，盘旋于咸阳城上空。
九条黑龙带着无比浓郁的龙威，俯视着下方的城主府。
而九条黑龙上空异象再生，一双金色的眼眸。
如同两颗炙热的太阳，带着浓郁的威压高悬于苍穹之上。
就在整座城主府在为小公子诞生时，所产生的惊天异象而高兴之际。
一声大笑再次惊到了所有人。
“哈哈哈哈哈~”
“两百年啊~”
“寡人等了整整两百年！！！”
“终于等到了，属于吾赢氏一族的天骄！”
“为了这一天，寡人一个人在那虚无而又枯寂之地等了，整整两百年！”
“如今看来，总算是没白待！”
随着声音的落下，一道身穿黑底金龙袍，头戴人皇冕，腰挎人皇剑。
浑身散发着恐怖威压的高大身影。

缓缓浮现在，此时有些昏昏欲睡的婴儿的身边。
威严的身影，一双深邃的目光在看到婴儿后。
那泰山崩于前而面不改色的神情中，不时的闪过几分喜色。
“哈哈哈~天运帝眸，远超武神躯的帝神躯，举世无双的天生神力。”
“剑骨，戟心，锤魂，天生的练武奇才啊！”
“这…竟还有儒家的先天浩然正气！”
“哈哈哈哈哈~好好好！天资傲人，简直就是一个小怪物啊~日后必能重现吾大秦神威！”
踏踏踏~
一阵阵急促的脚步声，从屋外传来。
几十道男女老少的身影，不一会儿就出现在了房间之中。
这群人中，以一位看上去二十四五岁，身穿锦袍面容英俊的年轻人为首。
竟全部向着，那道威严的身影磕头跪拜。
“赢氏一族，第一百八十七代族长，赢鸿，携七十五位赢氏一族嫡系后裔，拜见先祖！”
威严的身影，转身看向屋内的青年，微微点头说道：“嗯~起来吧。”
“谢，先祖。”xN
待众人起身后，威严的身影再次开口。
“赢鸿，寡人问你，冥界已经降临两百年了，经过了两百余年的繁衍生息。”
“赢氏一族的人丁，为何还是如此稀少？”
赢鸿根本没想到，先祖竟然会有这么一问，先是一愣。
随后回道：“额~回先祖，赢氏一族的嫡系，并非只有先祖所见到的这七十四人。”
content_en:
Underworld, Qin Territory, Xianyang City.
It was twelve o'clock at noon, when the sun was shining brightly.
A baby's cry broke the peace in the usually solemn Xianyang City.
Countless dark energy gathered crazily towards the Xianyang City Lord's Mansion.
It went straight to the place where the baby was crying and poured into the baby's body.
The blazing sun in the sky, which was originally glowing with golden light, suddenly turned purple.
Then nine black dragon phantoms appeared, hovering over Xianyang City.
The nine black dragons looked down at the City Lord's Mansion below with extremely strong dragon power.
And the vision reappeared above the nine black dragons, with a pair of golden eyes.
Like two scorching suns, they hang high in the sky with strong pressure.
Just when the entire city lord's palace was rejoicing at the shocking vision that occurred when the young master was born.
A loud laugh startled everyone again.
"Hahahahaha~"
"Two hundred years~"
"I have been waiting for two hundred years!!!"
"Finally, the wait is here, the genius who belongs to my Ying clan!"
"For this day, I have been waiting alone in that empty and lonely place for two hundred years!"
"Now it seems that my wait was finally not in vain!"
As the voice fell, a man was wearing a black gold dragon robe, a human emperor crown on his head, and a human emperor sword on his waist.
A tall figure exuding terrifying pressure.
Slowly appeared next to the baby who was a little sleepy at this time.
A majestic figure and a pair of deep eyes after seeing the baby.
In his unchanging expression even as Mount Tai collapsed in front of him, a hint of joy flashed from time to time.
"Hahaha~ Tianyun Emperor's Eyes, the emperor's divine body far surpasses that of the Martial God, and his innate divine power that is unparalleled in the world."
"Sword bone, halberd heart, hammer soul, a natural martial arts wizard!"
"This... actually has the innate righteousness of Confucianism!"
"Hahahahaha~ OK, OK! He is so talented, he is just like a little monster~ I will definitely be able to reproduce the divine power of my Great Qin in the future!"
Tap tap tap~
Bursts of rapid footsteps came from outside the house.
Dozens of figures of men, women, and children soon appeared in the room.
This group of people was led by a young man who looked to be in his mid-twenties, wearing a brocade robe and a handsome face.
They all kowtowed and knelt before that majestic figure.
"Ying Hong, the 187th generation patriarch of the Ying clan, brings seventy-five direct descendants of the Ying clan to pay homage to our ancestors!"
The majestic figure turned to look at the young man in the room, nodded slightly and said, "Well~ get up."
"Thank you, ancestor." xN
After everyone stood up, the majestic figure spoke again.
"Yinghong, I want to ask you, the underworld has been here for two hundred years, and after more than two hundred years of reproduction."
"Why are there still so few people in the Ying clan?"
Yinghong never expected that his ancestor would ask such a question, and was stunned at first.
Then he replied: "Well, back to our ancestors, the direct descendants of the Ying clan are not the only seventy-four people our ancestors saw."
